title: swida pumila
intro: Swida pumila, commonly known as dwarf alder, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Eastern Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a useful treatment for various conditions such as arthritis, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Swida pumila include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Swida pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
